verdict: Leads are arriving, but paid efficiency dipped and organic went quiet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 127 leads from Meta at a cost of $10.81 per lead, and the past week brought a 24% lift in lead volume. However, spend rose nearly 50% to produce that lift, so cost per lead climbed about 21% week over week — paid efficiency is under pressure as budget scales. At the same time, your Google Business Profile went dark over several days this past week, reducing organic calls and direction requests that typically support lead flow at no added cost. On the pipeline side, 122 new opportunities were logged in the CRM this period with no appointments or closed wins recorded, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up rather than an ads problem. We're tightening the Meta campaign to recover efficiency, restoring GBP activity immediately, and working through intake to ensure leads are being contacted and booked.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period via Meta
average cost per lead over the last 28 days
organic Google Business Profile actions this period (calls, directions, site clicks)

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply this past week, with four days registering zero organic engagement — putting organic call flow at risk if paid spend ever pulls back.
watch_item.fix: GBP posting and activity are being restored this week to rebuild that organic baseline.
